cr_data.provenance: 1924, gifted from the artist to private collection (Canyon, TX); 1980, Santa Fe East Gallery (Santa Fe, NM); Keyes Family Collection (Santa Fe, NM); 17 August 2010, Bonhams & Butterfields, Los Angeles, sale California and Western Paintings & Sculpture [lot 159]; by May 2013, Hirschl & Adler (New York, NY); September 2013, sold by Hirschl & Adler (New York, NY) to the Chazen Museum of Art (Source: Chazen Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: There is no date inscribed on the monoprint. The date 1907-1908 is anecdotal based on the years O’Keeffe was in New York and studying at the Art Students League, when realist and impressionist William Merritt Chase was the League’s leader. (Source: Chazen Museum of Art, 2025)
